# Tugg

> Tugg is a global pay-to-pull rivalry game: visitors pay $1–$1,000 (whole US dollars) to pull a virtual rope toward their side of a matchup such as Pizza vs Burgers. Each round closes daily at 00:00 UTC and the side with more money wins bragging rights. It is paid entertainment only: there are no prizes, payouts or winnings.

All numbers on Tugg come from real, confirmed payments. Rounds that receive no pulls have no winner. Matchups are created by Tugg or by players ($9 standard, $29 featured for 7 days) and are checked by moderation; rejected matchups are refunded automatically. Payments are processed by Stripe.

Every matchup and rivalry page starts with a short, dated factual summary (UTC) of the current round, recent results and all-time totals that can be quoted directly.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tugg.lol/): Live matchups with today's rope positions.
- [How it works](https://tugg.lol/how-it-works): Pulls, rounds, tie-breaks and the 00:00 UTC close.
- [Leaderboards](https://tugg.lol/leaderboards): Biggest ropes ever, longest win streaks, most pulled today, top countries.
- [Hall of Fame](https://tugg.lol/hall-of-fame): Every past round winner with result cards.
- [Yesterday on Tugg](https://tugg.lol/recap): Daily recap written from stored facts, with a dated summary; archive at /recap/YYYY-MM-DD.
- [Stats](https://tugg.lol/stats): Site-wide totals.
- [Example matchup](https://tugg.lol/m/pizza-vs-burgers): Live round, rope, history and countries for one matchup.
- [Example rivalry](https://tugg.lol/rivalries/pizza-vs-burgers): "Who is winning?" page with live result, history and FAQ.
- [FAQ](https://tugg.lol/faq): Straight answers about pulls, rounds, payments and refunds.
- [Rules](https://tugg.lol/rules): What is and isn't allowed.

## Public feeds

- [Matchups (JSON)](https://tugg.lol/feeds/matchups.json): Every live matchup with current round totals.
- [Matchups (RSS)](https://tugg.lol/feeds/matchups.rss): New matchups.
- [Daily results (JSON)](https://tugg.lol/feeds/results.json): Winners and final totals of each closed round.
- [Daily results (RSS)](https://tugg.lol/feeds/results.rss): Round winners as they are crowned.
- [Leaderboard (JSON)](https://tugg.lol/feeds/leaderboard.json): Biggest ropes, streaks, today's most pulled, top countries.
- [Leaderboard (RSS)](https://tugg.lol/feeds/leaderboard.rss): Biggest ropes ever.
- [Sitemap](https://tugg.lol/sitemap.xml): All public pages.

## Optional

- [Terms](https://tugg.lol/terms): Plain-English terms of use.
- [Refund policy](https://tugg.lol/refund-policy): Pulls are non-refundable; rejected matchups are refunded automatically.
- [Privacy](https://tugg.lol/privacy): What Tugg stores.
- [About / Legal](https://tugg.lol/about-legal): Business name and contact.
